layout.note: drawn at the physical placement size; include at width=\linewidth / \textwidth without scaling

rule: every plotted value is read from the inputs below; nothing is typed in

plotted_values.units: t = median restore time of one returning request (s), 32K-token context; ratio = t / t(best option in the row)
plotted_values.rule_best: best = fastest measured option in the row; low-rank counts only if its shown variant passes eps
plotted_values.rule_tie: tie = within max(5% (A5 registered tie rule), the row's noise delta from speed_<model>/noise.json) of the best

checks.what: Llama k19v29 SVD write cost, idle (s, 2 decimals)

notes: report_only.json has no run_id field; it is identified by path and sha256 (EVIDENCE M2 cites it with p11q_report.json).

The map is restore time only: it excludes the write-time per-item SVD of the low-rank format, paid once per 32K request when the KV is written (Llama k19v29 3.24 s idle / 6.21 s busy; results/icpe_h200/p11/time/wcost.csv, svd_k + svd_v medians).

Sources as in EVIDENCE.md section M: CPU tier / b32 / NFS class = p01b_cells.csv (sdpa; 10 runs per mode); b16 / b48 and recompute-all = speed_<model>/summary.csv (32K, 30 runs); low-rank + INT4 load-all = p11t_cells.csv (t_meas_s; load-all only, no Cake path). INT4 load-all on b16 / b48 is the per-block dequant path (D2), on CPU / b32 / NFS the load-all + one-shot unpack path (A5). NFS recompute-all and SSD class: NOT_MEASURED.
